units: Gen. R. s. 42 (expl. העברי, v. preced.) כל העולם כולו מֵעֵ׳ אחד וכ׳ the whole world was on one side (idolaters), and he (Abraham) on the other side; שהוא מע׳ הנהר וכ׳ because he came from the banks of the river (Euphrates), and spoke the Hebrew language (v. עִבְרִו).—מע׳ לים beyond the sea.
<cite ref="Eruvin 55a">Erub. 55ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 30:12">Deut. XXX, 12</cite>) … <he>אם מע׳ לים לעבור אחריה</he> if the Law be beyond the sea, thou must go over to learn it.
